name: Growthpoint Properties Limited
source: Growthpoint Properties Limited Group and Company Annual Financial Statements 2026 for the year ended 30 June 2026, statement of profit or loss and other comprehensive income, GROUP columns, figures in Rm | Yahoo Finance fundamentals (the feed the JSE pipeline already reads); merged into blank cells only, cross-checked against the file's own Revenue/Total Equity/CFO anchor | FY2026 (year ended 30 June 2026) Operating Expenses, Operating Profit (EBIT) and Net Finance Costs completed from the Group statement of profit or loss and other comprehensive income in the Growthpoint Properties Limited Group and Company Annual Financial Statements 2026, audited by Ernst and Young Inc, published 9 September 2026. Operating profit 7 991 Rm and finance expense 4 239 Rm are printed lines; Operating Expenses 1 056 Rm is the net of the printed Other administrative and operating overheads (1 072 Rm) and the ECL movement on trade receivables credit (16 Rm), the two lines between net property income and operating profit, so Gross Profit less Operating Expenses equals Operating Profit. Figures in ZAR (Rm). | CRON 20261007d: FY2023 Profit Before Tax 2 067 and Net Profit 1 827 (R millions) from the Growthpoint Properties Limited Group summarised audited annual results for the year ended 30 June 2023, statement of profit or loss and other comprehensive income, GROUP column, published on the issuer results site growthpoint-ir.co.za: Total revenue 13 740, property-related expenses (3 968), net property income 9 814, other administrative and operating overheads (931), operating profit 8 883, finance expense (4 356), Profit before taxation 2 067, Taxation (240), Profit for the year 1 827; profit attributable to owners of the company 2 356 and non-controlling interests (529). Profit Before Tax less Income Tax equals Net Profit against the Income Tax of 240 000 000 already stored for FY2023. Audited by Ernst and Young Inc.
